# graviteeam_factor (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM MFA Factor

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_factor" "example" {
  domain_id   = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name        = "TOTP Authenticator"
  factor_type = "TOTP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this factor belongs to
- `factor_type` (String) The type of factor: TOTP, EMAIL, or SMS
- `name` (String) The name of the factor

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the factor
